files.style.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;color:#edeef4;background:#101725}header{height:52px;text-align:center;padding:12px 52px;position:relative;z-index:3}h1{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:3px;margin:0;font-weight:550}main{height:calc(100% - 52px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink,#eef1f7);border:1px solid var(--line,#5b6577);border-radius:12px;background:var(--card,#252e40);font-size:14px;padding:9px 12px;min-height:38px}button{cursor:pointer}button:disabled{opacity:.45}textarea{resize:none}label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-size:12px;color:#abb9cc}.actions{position:absolute;bottom:23px;left:18px;right:18px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px}.actions button{white-space:nowrap}.foot{position:absolute;bottom:5px;width:100%;text-align:center;color:#a8b4c7;font-size:10px}.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#b7bad1}.status{position:absolute;top:0;left:55px;right:16px;font-size:11px;color:#e0c994;text-align:center;z-index:4}.muted{font-size:12px;color:#b2b9ca;line-height:1.6}h2{font-size:25px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1px}p{line-height:1.65}.columns{display:flex;height:230px;align-items:center;padding:12px 26px;gap:25px}.art{width:204px;flex-shrink:0}.copy{flex:1}.copy h2{margin:10px 0}.form{padding:10px 26px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.scroll{overflow:auto;min-height:0}svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 40%,#28365d,#101725 75%)}.letter-preview{font-size:13px;max-height:66px;overflow:auto;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.editor{padding:15px 28px}.editor textarea{display:block;width:100%;height:140px;margin-top:12px;font-size:17px}.editor p{margin:7px 0}
